newsitem.title: USA: Atwood Oceanics files for 1.5 mln common.
newsitem.headline: Atwood Oceanics files for 1.5 mln common.

text.p: Atwood Oceanics Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 1.5 million common shares.
The company has granted the underwriters an over-allotment option to purchase up to 225,000 additional common shares, the filing said.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 8,231,488 common shares, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Credit Suisse First Boston, Howard, Weil, Labouisse, Friedrichs Inc and Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be used to upgrade and refurbish certain of the company's drilling rigs, to repay all amounts of outstanding under Atwood's bank facilities and for general corporate purposes, the company said.
Atwood, based in Houston, Texas, provides offshore contract drilling services to the oil and gas industry.
